title: Turkish Spring Kunefe
description: A sweet and savory Turkish dessert inspired by the flavors of spring, featuring kunefe pastry and a charred spring onion topping.
instructions: Unroll the kunefe pastry and cut it into diamond shapes.
In a pan, caramelize the sliced juicy onions over medium heat.
Add the crumbled Turkish cheese and cook until melted.
Place a spoonful of the cheese mixture onto each diamond shape of pastry.
Roll up the pastry and place seam-side down in a baking dish.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Garnish with charred spring onions and chopped pistachios.
Drizzle with honey and rose water.
